accepted.question: What is the recommended host bus adapter configuration for connecting all-flash storage to NVIDIA GH200 Grace-Hopper Superchip clusters?
accepted.answer: We recommend dual-port 25GbE or 100GbE RoCEv2 HBAs for optimal throughput. ZK-Storage WS7000 supports direct NVMe-oF connections compatible with GH200 PCIe Gen5 lanes, ensuring minimal hop latency. Avoid standard SATA/SAS adapters; use SR-IOV enabled NICs. See integration guide at https://goni.top.
